title: Compatibility with the two diagonal pullback sections
statement: For categories C,D, functors F1,F2:C -> D and G:D -> C, natural isomorphisms s_i:F_i followed by G isomorphic to Id_C, an object M of C and a morphism t:F2(M) -> F1(M), PullSectionCompatibility F1 F2 G s1 s2 M t is the proposition with the single field G(t) followed by s1(M) = s2(M). It has exactly this content. In its application to the projective diagonal, F_i are p_i^*, G is Delta^*, and s_i are the canonical section comparisons.
